Former President Joe Biden spoke to Nebraska Democrats in Omaha on Friday, November 7, 2025. Biden was a speaker at the 2025 Ben Nelson Gala, joining Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear and Capitol Police Officer Harry Dunn as featured speakers.

Biden spoke as part of the Nebraska Democratic Party's annual Ben Nelson Gala, referring to nationwide elections that saw Democrats win key races, including the New York City mayor's race and governor's races in Virginia and New Jersey.
